ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across the central fluke surface; high-contrast white mottling and irregular geometric blobs are restricted to the extreme distal 10% of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate wide angle (>100 degrees); minimal vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; right distal tip shows increased peak-to-valley amplitude (jagged appearance) compared to the central edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward-sweeping convex curve on the trailing edge boundary, terminating in tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixel circular patterns visible on the distal tips, particularly concentrated on the right lobe edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, eroded trailing edge on the distal right tip, suggesting minor tissue loss or persistent heavy scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct secondary indentation or chip located on the trailing edge immediately adjacent (left) to the primary median notch.
